raw_response: The figure presents a bar chart illustrating the 'effect' associated with different language families and model types. The horizontal axis represents language families, categorized as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled 'effect', displays values on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 5. Three data series are presented, each representing a different model: mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, and mBERT-B2, XLM-B2. Each series is represented by a set of bars, with error bars extending above and below each bar to indicate variability. The bars for mBERT-L2 are colored light green, XLM-L2 are light red, and mBERT-B2 and XLM-B2 are dark green and dark red, respectively. The bars are grouped by language family, with each language family having four bars corresponding to the four models. The shortest bars generally have values around 1, while the tallest bars reach approximately 28. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
